name: getFlagTracking
description: Returns whether the view is currently tracking the selected object. When enabled, the camera automatically follows the selected object as it moves across the sky.
returnDescription: true if tracking is enabled, false otherwise

name: setFlagTracking
description: Enables or disables tracking of the selected object. When enabled, the camera follows the selected object automatically.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: true to enable tracking, false to disable

name: getFlagLockEquPos
description: Returns whether the equatorial position is locked. When locked, the view direction remains fixed in equatorial coordinates regardless of time progression.
returnDescription: true if equatorial position is locked

name: setFlagLockEquPos
description: Locks or unlocks the equatorial position. When locked, the view remains fixed in equatorial coordinates as time passes.

parameters.name: locked
parameters.description: true to lock equatorial position, false to unlock

name: getEquatorialMount
description: Returns whether the mount mode is equatorial (true) or alt-azimuthal (false).
returnDescription: true for equatorial mount, false for alt-azimuthal

name: setEquatorialMount
description: Switches between equatorial mount and alt-azimuthal mount modes. Equatorial mode follows the celestial sphere rotation, while alt-azimuthal mode is fixed to the horizon.

parameters.name: equatorial
parameters.description: true for equatorial mount, false for alt-azimuthal

name: toggleMountMode
description: Toggles between equatorial and alt-azimuthal mount modes.
example:
// Toggle mount mode
StelMovementMgr.toggleMountMode();

name: getMountMode
description: Returns the current mount mode. Possible values: MountAltAzimuthal (0), MountEquinoxEquatorial (1), MountGalactic (2), MountSupergalactic (3).

name: setMountMode
description: Sets the mount mode. Controls the coordinate system used for view movement.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Mount mode (0=AltAz, 1=Equatorial, 2=Galactic, 3=Supergalactic)

name: getCurrentFov
description: Returns the current field of view in degrees.
example:
var fov = StelMovementMgr.getCurrentFov();
core.debug("Current FOV: " + fov + "°");

name: setFov
description: Sets the current field of view in degrees. Values are clamped between minFov and maxFov.

parameters.name: fov
parameters.description: Field of view in degrees

name: getAimFov
description: Returns the target field of view during smooth zoom animations. If not zooming, returns the current FOV.
returnDescription: Target FOV in degrees during animation
example:
var aimFov = StelMovementMgr.getAimFov();
core.debug("Target FOV: " + aimFov + "°");

name: zoomTo
description: Smoothly zooms to a target field of view over a specified duration.

parameters.name: aimFov
parameters.description: Target field of view in degrees

parameters.name: zoomDuration
parameters.description: Duration of the zoom animation in seconds

name: zoomIn
description: Starts or stops continuous zooming in (increasing magnification). Use with a timer for smooth zoom effects.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: true to start zooming in, false to stop

name: zoomOut
description: Starts or stops continuous zooming out (decreasing magnification).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: true to start zooming out, false to stop

name: autoZoomIn
description: Automatically zooms in on the currently selected object and optionally centers it. This is the action typically bound to the '/' key.

parameters.name: moveDuration
parameters.description: Duration for the zoom animation in seconds

parameters.name: allowManualZoom
parameters.description: If true, allows additional manual zooming beyond automatic level

name: autoZoomOut
description: Automatically zooms out, either to a satellite system view or to the initial view. This is the action typically bound to the '\' key.

parameters.name: moveDuration
parameters.description: Duration for the zoom animation in seconds

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: If true, zooms out fully to initial view even from satellite view

name: getInitFov
description: Returns the initial field of view set at startup (default 60 degrees).
example:
var initFov = StelMovementMgr.getInitFov();
core.debug("Initial FOV: " + initFov + "°");

name: setInitFov
description: Sets the initial field of view value. This will be used when resetting the view.

parameters.name: fov
parameters.description: Initial FOV in degrees

example: StelMovementMgr.setInitFov(45.0);

name: getMinFov
description: Returns the minimum allowed field of view (maximum zoom) in degrees.
returnDescription: Minimum FOV in degrees (default ~0.0014°, about 5 arcseconds)
example:
var minFov = StelMovementMgr.getMinFov();
core.debug("Maximum zoom: " + minFov + "°");

name: getMaxFov
description: Returns the maximum allowed field of view (maximum zoom out) in degrees.
returnDescription: Maximum FOV in degrees (depends on projection, up to 180° or 360°)
example:
var maxFov = StelMovementMgr.getMaxFov();
core.debug("Maximum FOV: " + maxFov + "°");

name: setMaxFov
description: Sets the maximum allowed field of view. Clamped by userMaxFov and projection limits.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Maximum FOV in degrees

example: StelMovementMgr.setMaxFov(180.0);

name: getUserMaxFov
description: Returns the user-configured maximum field of view limit (useful for planetarium domes).
example:
var userMax = StelMovementMgr.getUserMaxFov();
core.debug("User max FOV: " + userMax + "°");

name: setUserMaxFov
description: Sets the user-configured maximum field of view limit. Useful for planetarium domes where FOV should never exceed 180°.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Maximum FOV in degrees (1 to 360)

name: getFlagAutoZoomOutResetsDirection
description: Returns whether auto-zoom out resets the viewing direction to the initial position.
returnDescription: true if direction is reset on zoom out

name: setFlagAutoZoomOutResetsDirection
description: Sets whether auto-zoom out should reset the viewing direction to the initial position.

parameters.name: reset
parameters.description: true to reset direction on zoom out

example: StelMovementMgr.setFlagAutoZoomOutResetsDirection(true);

name: getFlagEnableMoveAtScreenEdge
description: Returns whether moving the mouse to the screen edge triggers view movement.
returnDescription: true if screen edge movement is enabled

name: setFlagEnableMoveAtScreenEdge
description: Enables or disables view movement when the mouse cursor reaches the screen edge.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: true to enable edge movement

example: StelMovementMgr.setFlagEnableMoveAtScreenEdge(true);

name: getFlagEnableMouseNavigation
description: Returns whether mouse dragging is enabled for view navigation.
returnDescription: true if mouse navigation is enabled

name: setFlagEnableMouseNavigation
description: Enables or disables mouse dragging for view navigation.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: true to enable mouse navigation

example: StelMovementMgr.setFlagEnableMouseNavigation(true);

name: getFlagEnableMouseZooming
description: Returns whether mouse wheel zooming is enabled.
returnDescription: true if mouse zooming is enabled

name: setFlagEnableMouseZooming
description: Enables or disables mouse wheel zooming.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: true to enable mouse zooming

example: StelMovementMgr.setFlagEnableMouseZooming(true);

name: getFlagEnableMoveKeys
description: Returns whether keyboard arrow keys are enabled for view movement.
returnDescription: true if movement keys are enabled

name: setFlagEnableMoveKeys
description: Enables or disables keyboard arrow keys for view movement.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: true to enable movement keys

example: StelMovementMgr.setFlagEnableMoveKeys(true);

name: getFlagEnableZoomKeys
description: Returns whether keyboard zoom keys (PageUp/PageDown) are enabled.
returnDescription: true if zoom keys are enabled

name: setFlagEnableZoomKeys
description: Enables or disables keyboard zoom keys (PageUp/PageDown).

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: true to enable zoom keys

example: StelMovementMgr.setFlagEnableZoomKeys(true);

name: getFlagIndicationMountMode
description: Returns whether an on-screen indicator shows the current mount mode (equatorial/alt-azimuthal).
returnDescription: true if mount mode indicator is shown

name: setFlagIndicationMountMode
description: Shows or hides the on-screen indicator for the current mount mode.

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: true to show indicator, false to hide

example: StelMovementMgr.setFlagIndicationMountMode(true);

name: getAutoMoveDuration
description: Returns the duration of automatic movement animations in seconds.
example:
var duration = StelMovementMgr.getAutoMoveDuration();
core.debug("Auto-move duration: " + duration + " seconds");

name: setAutoMoveDuration
description: Sets the duration of automatic movement animations in seconds.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Duration in seconds

name: getMovementSpeedFactor
description: Returns the global movement speed factor. Used to speed up or slow down all movements.
example:
var factor = StelMovementMgr.getMovementSpeedFactor();
core.debug("Speed factor: " + factor);

name: setMovementSpeedFactor
description: Sets the global movement speed factor. Values >1 speed up movements, <1 slow them down.

parameters.name: factor
parameters.description: Speed multiplier (e.g., 2.0 = twice as fast)

name: getViewDirectionJ2000
description: Returns the current view direction as a vector in the J2000 equatorial coordinate system.
returnDescription: View direction vector in J2000 coordinates
example:
var dir = StelMovementMgr.getViewDirectionJ2000();
core.debug("View direction: x=" + dir[0] + ", y=" + dir[1] + ", z=" + dir[2]);

name: setViewDirectionJ2000
description: Sets the view direction to a specific J2000 equatorial coordinate. Use with Vec3d constructed from coordinates.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: View direction vector in J2000 coordinates

name: getViewUpVectorJ2000
description: Returns the up vector (direction that is considered 'up' on screen) in J2000 equatorial coordinates.
example:
var up = StelMovementMgr.getViewUpVectorJ2000();
core.debug("Up vector: x=" + up[0] + ", y=" + up[1] + ", z=" + up[2]);

name: setViewUpVectorJ2000
description: Sets the up vector (direction considered 'up' on screen) in J2000 equatorial coordinates.

parameters.name: up
parameters.description: Up vector in J2000 coordinates

name: setViewUpVector
description: Sets the up vector in the current mount frame coordinates.

parameters.name: up
parameters.description: Up vector in current mount frame

name: getInitViewingDirection
description: Returns the initial viewing direction as a vector in Alt/Az coordinates.
example:
var initDir = StelMovementMgr.getInitViewingDirection();
core.debug("Initial view direction: " + initDir);

name: setInitViewDirectionToCurrent
description: Sets the initial viewing direction to the current view direction. The setting is saved to the configuration file.

name: resetInitViewPos
description: Resets the view to the initial position and orientation as configured at startup.
example:
// Return to default view
StelMovementMgr.resetInitViewPos();

name: moveToObject
signature: moveToObject(StelObjectP target, float moveDuration, ZoomingMode zooming)
description: Smoothly moves the view to center on a specific celestial object.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Target object to center view on

parameters.name: moveDuration
parameters.description: Duration of the move animation in seconds

parameters.name: zooming
parameters.description: Zoom mode (-1=out, 0=none, 1=in)

example:
var mars = core.getObjectInfo("Mars");
StelMovementMgr.moveToObject(mars, 2.0, 1);

name: moveToJ2000
signature: moveToJ2000(Vec3d aim, Vec3d aimUp, float moveDuration, ZoomingMode zooming)
description: Smoothly moves the view to a specific J2000 equatorial coordinate.

parameters.name: aim
parameters.description: Target J2000 direction vector

parameters.name: aimUp
parameters.description: Up vector for the target view

parameters.name: moveDuration
parameters.description: Duration in seconds

parameters.name: zooming
parameters.description: Zoom mode (-1=out, 0=none, 1=in)

name: moveToAltAzi
signature: moveToAltAzi(Vec3d aim, Vec3d aimUp, float moveDuration, ZoomingMode zooming)
description: Smoothly moves the view to a specific Altitude/Azimuth coordinate. Only works in Alt-Azimuth mount mode.

parameters.name: aim
parameters.description: Target Alt/Az direction vector

parameters.name: aimUp
parameters.description: Up vector for the target view

parameters.name: moveDuration
parameters.description: Duration in seconds

parameters.name: zooming
parameters.description: Zoom mode (-1=out, 0=none, 1=in)

compatibility.notes: Only works in Alt-Azimuth mount mode

name: panView
description: Pans the view by adding azimuth and altitude offsets to the current direction.

parameters.name: deltaAz
parameters.description: Azimuth change in radians

parameters.name: deltaAlt
parameters.description: Altitude change in radians

example:
// Pan 10 degrees east and 5 degrees up
StelMovementMgr.panView(10 * Math.PI/180, 5 * Math.PI/180);

name: turnRight
description: Starts or stops continuous panning to the right (east direction).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: true to start, false to stop

name: turnLeft
description: Starts or stops continuous panning to the left (west direction).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: true to start, false to stop

name: turnUp
description: Starts or stops continuous panning upward (toward zenith/north pole).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: true to start, false to stop

name: turnDown
description: Starts or stops continuous panning downward (toward nadir/south pole).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: true to start, false to stop

name: moveSlow
description: Enables or disables slow movement mode (reduces movement speed to 20%).

parameters.name: slow
parameters.description: true for slow movement, false for normal speed

name: lookEast
description: Immediately points the view toward the eastern horizon. If zero is true, centers on the horizon; if false, keeps current altitude.

parameters.name: zero
parameters.description: true to center on horizon, false to keep altitude

name: lookWest
description: Immediately points the view toward the western horizon.

parameters.name: zero
parameters.description: true to center on horizon, false to keep altitude

example: StelMovementMgr.lookWest(true);

name: lookNorth
description: Immediately points the view toward the northern horizon.

parameters.name: zero
parameters.description: true to center on horizon, false to keep altitude

example: StelMovementMgr.lookNorth(true);

name: lookSouth
description: Immediately points the view toward the southern horizon.

parameters.name: zero
parameters.description: true to center on horizon, false to keep altitude

example: StelMovementMgr.lookSouth(true);

name: lookZenith
description: Immediately points the view straight up (zenith).
example:
// Look directly overhead
StelMovementMgr.lookZenith();

name: lookNadir
description: Immediately points the view straight down (nadir).
example:
// Look directly down
StelMovementMgr.lookNadir();

name: lookTowardsNCP
description: Immediately points the view toward the North Celestial Pole.
example:
// Look at Polaris region
StelMovementMgr.lookTowardsNCP();

name: lookTowardsSCP
description: Immediately points the view toward the South Celestial Pole.
example: StelMovementMgr.lookTowardsSCP();

name: deselection
description: Deselects the currently selected object and disables equatorial position lock.
example:
// Clear current selection
StelMovementMgr.deselection();

name: reSelectLastObject
description: Re-selects the last object that was selected.
example:
// Re-select previously selected object
StelMovementMgr.reSelectLastObject();

name: moveViewport
signature: moveViewport(double offsetX, double offsetY, float duration)
description: Animates the viewport offset, allowing the view center to be shifted. Useful for planetarium domes or panoramic displays.

parameters.name: offsetX
parameters.description: Horizontal offset percentage (-50 to 50)

parameters.name: offsetY
parameters.description: Vertical offset percentage (-50 to 50)

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Animation duration in seconds

name: getViewportOffsetTarget
description: Returns the target viewport offset values (horizontal, vertical).
example:
var target = StelMovementMgr.getViewportOffsetTarget();
core.debug("Target offset: H=" + target[0] + "%, V=" + target[1] + "%");

name: getViewportHorizontalOffsetTarget
description: Returns the target horizontal viewport offset percentage.
returnDescription: Horizontal offset target in percent (-50 to 50)
example:
var hOffset = StelMovementMgr.getViewportHorizontalOffsetTarget();
core.debug("Horizontal offset target: " + hOffset + "%");

name: setViewportHorizontalOffsetTarget
description: Sets the target horizontal viewport offset percentage.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Horizontal offset percentage (-50 to 50)

example: StelMovementMgr.setViewportHorizontalOffsetTarget(10);

name: getViewportVerticalOffsetTarget
description: Returns the target vertical viewport offset percentage.
returnDescription: Vertical offset target in percent (-50 to 50)
example:
var vOffset = StelMovementMgr.getViewportVerticalOffsetTarget();
core.debug("Vertical offset target: " + vOffset + "%");

name: setViewportVerticalOffsetTarget
description: Sets the target vertical viewport offset percentage.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Vertical offset percentage (-50 to 50)

example: StelMovementMgr.setViewportVerticalOffsetTarget(-15);

name: setInhibitAllAutomoves
description: Inhibits all automatic movements (tracking, auto-centering, etc.). Useful for planetarium setups where manual control should be absolute.

parameters.name: inhibit
parameters.description: true to inhibit all automoves, false to allow

name: setDragTriggerDistance
description: Sets the minimum mouse movement distance (in pixels) required to trigger dragging.

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: Trigger distance in pixels

example: StelMovementMgr.setDragTriggerDistance(5.0);

name: smoothPan
signature: smoothPan(double deltaX, double deltaY, double duration, bool enable)
description: Starts or stops smooth panning by a predetermined amount over a specified duration.

parameters.name: deltaX
parameters.description: Horizontal pan amount in degrees

parameters.name: deltaY
parameters.description: Vertical pan amount in degrees

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Duration for the pan in seconds

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: true to start panning, false to stop

example:
// Smoothly pan 30 degrees right over 2 seconds
StelMovementMgr.smoothPan(30, 0, 2.0, true);
